analysis.session_summary: Asia was dominated by the RBNZ: OCR held at 2.75% vs 3.00% forecast, sending NZD down 1.391%. AUD led on its CPI beat and CAD firmed after an inline BoC hike. EUR, USD and JPY had no direct catalysts and chopped. Risk headlines (Iran diplomacy) caused late swings but VIX fell 2.337%.

themes.evidence: NZD strength -0.951%; AUD/NZD +1.206%; NZD/USD -1.114% on OCR hold 2.75% vs 3.00% forecast.
AUD strength +0.277% after CPI 0.8% vs 0.7%; CAD +0.239% after inline BoC 2.50%.
Multiple legs lacked clear catalysts; VIX -2.337%; Iran diplomacy headlines caused late reversals.

currency_drivers.USD: USD had no own catalyst; held range with modest bid.
currency_drivers.EUR: EUR had no own catalyst; selling was rejected and it recovered.
currency_drivers.JPY: JPY had no catalyst; early strength was rejected.
currency_drivers.GBP: GBP budget release muted; no driver from it.
currency_drivers.AUD: AUD led on hotter CPI beat and held gains.
currency_drivers.CAD: CAD strengthened after inline BoC hike; no surprise but still bid.
currency_drivers.CHF: CHF had no catalyst; held range with slight strength.
currency_drivers.NZD: NZD fell sharply on RBNZ hold/dovish surprise; weakest major.

leg_notes.EUR/USD: EUR/USD legs had no clear catalyst: initial down 20.4 pips, mid up 33.0 pips, then late down 11.0 pips.

polarity_reads.read: NZD sold 1.391% on a dovish miss; market was positioned for a hike, not a hold.
AUD gained 0.108% on a modest beat; longs were comfortable adding.
CAD gained 0.085% despite an inline decision; positioning expected a more dovish BoC.
No scored surprise; NZD slipped another 0.220%, suggesting continued selling pressure.

scenarios.name: Carry continues; commodity FX bid
scenarios.thesis: RBNZ shock fades; AUD and CAD hold gains as FOMC/ECB stay neutral.
scenarios.invalidation: Hawkish FOMC or sharp risk-off headline.

pair_paths.rationale: AUD remains strongest on CPI beat.
CAD retains bid after inline BoC hike.

scenarios.name: Hawkish USD repricing
scenarios.thesis: FOMC or US data surprises hawkish, lifting USD across the board.
triggers: Advance GDP q/q prints 3.2% or above
scenarios.invalidation: Dovish FOMC or weak US data.

pair_paths.rationale: EUR no own catalyst, USD bid.

scenarios.name: Risk-off / Iran headlines
scenarios.thesis: Iran diplomacy fails and risk sentiment sours, favoring JPY and CHF.

risks.why_it_matters: Would break USD range and lift USD/JPY sharply.
risks.watch: Powell press conference and statement language.

risks.why_it_matters: Headlines drove late legs; failure would boost safe havens.
risks.watch: Iran Foreign Minister statements and US/WSJ reports.

risks.why_it_matters: NZD remains weakest; AUD/NZD momentum can extend.

analysis.calendar_ahead_note: FOMC and ECB decisions due: Fed Funds expected 4.00%, ECB main rate 2.65%; US GDP 3.2% and Core PCE 0.3% also due. Press conferences are the main risk for USD and EUR.
